'''Reinhard Jahn''' (born 21 December 1950) is a German [[biophysicist]] and [[neurobiologist]] known for his studies of cellular membrane fusion. For these investigations, he has been honored with numerous awards, including the 2000 [[Leibniz Award]]. Jahn is currently director at the [[Max Planck Institute for Biophysical Chemistry]] and the president of the [[University of Göttingen]] in [[Göttingen]], Germany.

==Early life and education==
Reinhard Jahn was born in [[Leverkusen]], Germany, in 1950. He moved to Göttingen to study biology and biochemistry. Working in the lab of Hans-Dieter Söling, in 1981 he received a PhD from the University of Göttingen.

==Career and research==
Jahn moved to New York City to work as a postdoc in the lab of [[Paul Greengard]], where he went on to become an assistant professor at [[The Rockefeller University]]. In 1986 he returned to Germany as a junior group leader at the [[Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry]] in Munich. In 1991 he moved to [[New Haven]] to join the faculty at the [[Yale School of Medicine]], where he became a [[Howard Hughes Medical Institute]] Investigator.<ref name="HHMI">{{cite web | title=Reinhard Jahn, PhD | website=HHMI | url=https://www.hhmi.org/scientists/reinhard-jahn | access-date=27 November 2021}}</ref> He was recruited back to his alma mater to become director at the Max Planck Institute for Biophysical Chemistry, position which he holds currently.<ref name=nas/> In 2019 he was additionally elected as president of the University of Göttingen.

* 1990: Max Planck Research Award
* 2000: [[Leibniz Prize]]

* 2006: [[Ernst Jung Prize]]
* 2008: Sir Bernard Katz Prize
* 2010: Lower Saxony Science Award
* 2014: [[Heinrich Wieland Prize]]
* 2015: Foreign associate of the [[National Academy of Sciences]] (United States)<ref name=nas>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.nasonline.org/directory-entry/reinhard-jahn-ugzwmq/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190324141317/http://www.nasonline.org/member-directory/members/20035912.html |title=Reinhard Jahn |publisher=National Academy of Sciences |date= |url-status=live|archive-date=24 March 2019}}</ref>
* 2015: Member of the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Jahn_Reinhard |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190328142234/https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Jahn_Reinhard |title=Reinhard Jahn |publisher=Academia Europaea |date= |archive-date=28 March 2019}}</ref>
* 2015: Full member of the [[Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities]]<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://adw-goe.de/mitglieder/personendetails/person/reinhard-jahn/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160507075030/https://adw-goe.de/mitglieder/personendetails/person/reinhard-jahn/ |title=Prof. Dr. Reinhard Jahn |publisher=Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities |date= |archive-date=7 May 2016|url-status=live}}</ref>
